description: MOVE of an alphanumeric figurative constant (QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, non-digit ALL literal) to a numeric or numeric-edited item - permitted through 2014 (pre-removal semantics per the legacy oracle, provisional per ratified decision 1; implemented on the StoreAsImage substrate), REMOVED by ISO 2023 (Annex E.2 item 1 bullet 1; 14.9.25.3 SR5) except the digit-only-ALL-to-integer case; QUOTE rides its own dual row move-quote-numeric-obsolete-2014 (obsolete 2014 first, Annex E.2 item 21 - the adversarial-review correction). Documented residues (DEVLOG 595): pre-removal image semantics cover elementary numeric-DISPLAY receivers - a Tier-A REDEFINES-class or BINARY/PACKED/COMP-5/float receiver stays a NARROW runtime-loud guard (legal-per-ISO-2014 shapes, no corpus hits); a MULTI-CHARACTER ALL literal is not this row's - it is 8.3.3.6.3 SR3's, row all-literal-multichar-numeric-removed-2002 (kb/Work PB422, VCR 7.13). SPACE is NOT this row's (kb/Work PB3605): 'The figurative constant SPACE shall not be moved to a numeric or numeric-edited item' is syntax rule 5 of ISO/IEC 1989:2002 clause 14.8.24.2 and of the 2009 committee draft that led to 2014, and VCR row 7.41 derives the same at 1985, so MOVE SPACE to a numeric or numeric-edited item is refused at every edition by the binder's MOVE chain (MoveValidity.FigurativeRefusal, COBOL0819). Gate: VersionConformancePass.GateSr5 (W2 track A, DEVLOG 593; PB879). ASKED BY EVERY ASKER OF THE MOVE RULES (kb/Work PB3755), through the one body FigurativeAssociation.GateSr5: the written MOVE and every implicit FROM/INTO move (VersionConformancePass.GateMove), INITIALIZE REPLACING's hypothetical MOVE (VersionConformancePass.GateInitialize, 14.9.20.3 SR4) and a figurative argument BY CONTENT into a numeric-edited formal parameter of a CALL, an INVOKE or a user-defined function (ParameterConformance.GateFigurativeEdition; 14.8.2.3.3 rule 2 d: the formal is not numeric, so the MOVE rules apply, not rule 2 a's COMPUTE).
